name: usage-bars
description: Your Claude Code 5-hour and 7-day usage limits as animated bars under the prompt: percent, reset countdown, pace mark, projection, per-answer delta, styles (Pac-Man, beer, tank, battery, hourglass)

style.title: Style
style.description: How the bars look: bars, pacman, beer, tank, battery or hourglass (switch any time with /usage-bars style)

mode.title: Display
mode.description: full: bars · compact: numbers only · off: hidden

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the line, toasts and commands: en or de

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: Gliding bars, delta flash, reset sparkle; off = a calm, static line

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: A chime at 90/100 % and on reset

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: A toast at 50/80/90/100 %, once per window

face.title: Face
face.description: An emoji that follows your pace
